resources.string: Shown while PocketIDE is connected to your Cloud Shell, or setting up that connection. Has a Disconnect button.

Keeps the user\'s own encrypted connection to their Google Cloud Shell open (Google\'s gcloud over SSH) while they use the agents in PocketIDE or finish a sign-in page in the browser, shows that it is open, and lets the user close it.
Ubuntu and Google\'s gcloud, on this phone. It continues if you switch apps.
Finish Google\'s page in Chrome, then come back.
A file an agent gave you, on its way to the phone\'s Downloads (Download/PocketIDE), and when it is there.
In Download/PocketIDE. Tap to open it.
In Download/PocketIDE. Tap to open your downloads, then tap it to install.
